WHERE p.payment_date<=… 会过滤掉所有没有付款（或付款晚于 1 月底）的发票，LEFT JOIN 失去保留全部发票的作用。把日期条件移到 ON 里，只限制“哪些付款算数”，发票仍然全部保留，COALESCE 把没有付款的合计换成 0。
另一种写法：先在子查询里筛出 1 月底前的付款，再左连接。

commonErrors.sql: SELECT i.invoice_id,COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0) AS paid FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN payments p ON i.invoice_id=p.invoice_id WHERE p.payment_date<='2026-01-31' GROUP BY i.invoice_id
commonErrors.reason: 日期条件放在 WHERE 里，会过滤掉没有付款的发票，应放进 ON。

questions.title: 付款汇总后计算发票余额
questions.context: 财务要计算每张发票还有多少余额没收回，一张发票可能分多次付款。
questions.requirements:
按发票输出 invoice_id 和余额 balance（发票金额减已付款合计，没有付款按 0 计算）。
输出字段名称及顺序：invoice_id, balance

referenceSolutions.mysqlSql: WITH p AS (SELECT invoice_id,SUM(amount) AS paid FROM payments GROUP BY invoice_id) SELECT i.invoice_id,i.amount-COALESCE(p.paid,0) AS balance FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN p ON i.invoice_id=p.invoice_id
referenceSolutions.sqliteSql: WITH p AS (SELECT invoice_id,SUM(amount) AS paid FROM payments GROUP BY invoice_id) SELECT i.invoice_id,i.amount-COALESCE(p.paid,0) AS balance FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN p ON i.invoice_id=p.invoice_id

referenceSolutions.mysqlSql: SELECT i.invoice_id,i.amount-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments p WHERE p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id),0) AS balance FROM invoices i
referenceSolutions.sqliteSql: SELECT i.invoice_id,i.amount-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments p WHERE p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id),0) AS balance FROM invoices i

hints: 一张发票可能有多条付款记录，先把每张发票的付款合并成一个合计再计算余额。
先对付款表按发票分组求和，再把结果左连接到发票表。
没有付款的发票合计是 NULL，需要换成 0 再相减。
questions.explanation:
先用子查询（这里用 WITH）把付款按发票汇总成每张发票一行，再左连接到发票表，余额 = 发票金额 − COALESCE(付款合计,0)。这样每张发票只出现一次，没有付款的发票余额等于发票金额。
易错：用 MAX 只取最大的一笔付款，分多次付款的发票余额会算错。
另一种写法：用相关子查询在 SELECT 里直接取每张发票的付款合计。

commonErrors.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT invoice_id,MAX(amount) AS paid FROM payments GROUP BY invoice_id) SELECT i.invoice_id,i.amount-COALESCE(p.paid,0) AS balance FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN p ON i.invoice_id=p.invoice_id
commonErrors.reason: 付款合计应使用 SUM；MAX 只取最大的一笔，分次付款的发票余额会算错。

questions.title: 客户订单金额与数量
questions.context: 客户经理想比较每位客户的订单总额和订单数，没下过单的客户也要显示。
questions.requirements:
每位客户输出 customer_id、订单销售额合计 total（没有订单为 0）和订单数 n（没有订单为 0）。
输出字段名称及顺序：customer_id, total, n

referenceSolutions.mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,SUM(sales) AS total,COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id,COALESCE(a.total,0) AS total,COALESCE(a.n,0) AS n FROM customers c LEFT JOIN a ON c.customer_id=a.customer_id
referenceSolutions.sqliteSql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,SUM(sales) AS total,COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id,COALESCE(a.total,0) AS total,COALESCE(a.n,0) AS n FROM customers c LEFT JOIN a ON c.customer_id=a.customer_id

referenceSolutions.mysqlSql: SELECT c.customer_id,COALESCE(SUM(o.sales),0) AS total,COUNT(o.id) AS n FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id
referenceSolutions.sqliteSql: SELECT c.customer_id,COALESCE(SUM(o.sales),0) AS total,COUNT(o.id) AS n FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id

hints: 结果的粒度是“每位客户一行”，包括没有订单的客户。
先把订单按客户汇总成一行，再和客户表左连接，可以避免一对多重复。
没有订单的客户汇总结果是 NULL，要换成 0。
questions.explanation:
先把订单按 customer_id 汇总出 total 和 n，再让 customers 左连接这份汇总，没有订单的客户用 COALESCE 补 0。
易错：把汇总表和客户表做内连接，没有订单的客户会消失。
另一种写法：customers 直接 LEFT JOIN orders 后按客户分组，用 COALESCE(SUM(o.sales),0) 和 COUNT(o.id)。

commonErrors.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,SUM(sales) AS total,COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id,COALESCE(a.total,0) AS total,COALESCE(a.n,0) AS n FROM customers c JOIN a ON c.customer_id=a.customer_id
commonErrors.reason: 内连接会丢掉没有订单的客户，应使用左连接。

questions.title: 采购订购量与收货量
questions.context: 采购部要核对每条采购明细订了多少、实际收了多少，还没收货的明细也要显示。
questions.requirements:

referenceSolutions.mysqlSql: WITH r AS (SELECT po_item_id,SUM(quantity_received) AS received FROM receipts GROUP BY po_item_id) SELECT i.po_item_id,i.quantity_ordered,COALESCE(r.received,0) AS received FROM purchase_items i LEFT JOIN r ON i.po_item_id=r.po_item_id
referenceSolutions.sqliteSql: WITH r AS (SELECT po_item_id,SUM(quantity_received) AS received FROM receipts GROUP BY po_item_id) SELECT i.po_item_id,i.quantity_ordered,COALESCE(r.received,0) AS received FROM purchase_items i LEFT JOIN r ON i.po_item_id=r.po_item_id

referenceSolutions.mysqlSql: SELECT i.po_item_id,i.quantity_ordered,COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_received),0) AS received FROM purchase_items i LEFT JOIN receipts r ON i.po_item_id=r.po_item_id GROUP BY i.po_item_id,i.quantity_ordered
referenceSolutions.sqliteSql: SELECT i.po_item_id,i.quantity_ordered,COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_received),0) AS received FROM purchase_items i LEFT JOIN receipts r ON i.po_item_id=r.po_item_id GROUP BY i.po_item_id,i.quantity_ordered
